budget: 60 cumulative Session.run seconds across every arm and phase, checked between and after calls; a single in-flight call cannot be preempted
timing_boundary: CPU Session.run service summed across all packets, including startup. Encoding, preparation, validation, loop overhead and disk writes excluded and recorded separately where applicable.
cpu_default: CPU 0, one intra-op/inter-op/native-library thread; CPUExecutionProvider only
precision_note: FLOAT input/output is not a precision claim; each graph and native library is identified by hash. INT8-versus-FP32 differences are descriptive, not an allclose gate.
streaming_note: A fresh state per utterance, retained across packets. No graph switch for terminal 40 ms AudioVAE packets. No future packets or extra flush latents supplied.

cohort.selection: Shortest complete original recording within each of six preselected languages, chosen without model outputs or quality scores; UID breaks ties. Small screen only.

dataset.selection: Seeded per-language sample of full 4-12 second utterances. Target 3 per supplied gender label where available; fill any missing quota from remaining eligible utterances in the same seeded order. No model output or quality score used for selection. No speaker IDs available for speaker balancing.
dataset.normalization: None; original floating-point decoded samples saved losslessly as FLOAT WAV.

scoring_note: Build the local scoring manifest only after download and hash verification. This receipt is an export inventory, not predictor scores.
